context: Create an operator runbook docs/operations/merge-queue-canary-runbook.md. Configure a temporary test queue on a smoke branch or sandbox repo. Submit test PRs, verify merge_group webhook dispatch and workflow completion, and confirm that soundness PRs cannot auto-enqueue.
description: Phase 4 / Gate MQ-4. Execute an end-to-end rehearsal of the native merge queue on an isolated test branch or repository before modifying the primary develop ruleset. Validate 3 synthetic PR scenarios: a docs PR (fast path), a code PR (full matrix), and a soundness PR (asserts auto-enqueue withholding). Verify merge group formation, CI execution, and clean squash integration.

anti_patterns.dont: Run canary tests directly on production develop branch
anti_patterns.instead: Rehearse on a disposable branch or sandbox first
anti_patterns.why: Failed queue experiments freeze all open PRs and disrupt maintainers

preserves.behavior: All 3 required status checks proven reporting on merge_group before develop rollout
develop ruleset untouched during canary rehearsal
